correctness.rationale: Exact nullcline substitution yields F(q) and a complete positive quadratic census for all strictly positive model parameters. The determinant equals a strictly negative coefficient times F'(q), and the trace is strictly negative for both positive roots in the wedge using the exact minimum 2(sqrt(2)-1)>1/2. The boundary eigenvalues and nondegenerate fold have explicit formulas. The original-ODE SymPy checker verified the reduction and exact rational root/Jacobian signs; finite tests are not treated as proof of the all-parameter theorem.
